products.title: Soto Boots Womens Lola Fashion Cowboy Boots M50047
products.description: If you’re looking for embroidered country boots that are ideal for a wedding or other formal event, these fashion cowboy boots will turn heads and help you achieve an authentic country girl look. Rhinestone and metallic studs adorn the beautiful overlay design in the brown distressed leather. A snip toe and a moderate heel height of 1.5 inches finishes them off for a complete feminine look. Handcrafted in León, Guanajuato, Mexico, these country wedding boots are of the finest quality and construction. Goodyear welt construction ensures that they’re built to last, while leather lining and a leather sole make them comfortable to wear for long hours of dancing and mingling. Keep your step with the stacked leather heel with a rubber cap so you won’t slip on the dance floor. These embroidered boots are the perfect accessory whether you’re a bride, bridesmaid, or just want to make an impression and show off a little bit of your country side.
